changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO moonpark_pricing_data.user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT u.user_id, r.role_id FROM moonpark_pricing_data.app_user u JOIN moonpark_master_data.role r ON (u.username = 'test.user' AND r.role_name = 'USER') OR (u.username = 'test.admin' AND r.role_name IN ('ADMIN', 'USER')) OR (u.username = 'test.superadmin' AND r.role_name = 'SUPER_ADMIN') ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_id) DO NOTHING;
